concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Comparing percent dose normalized plasma concentrations (Figure 8), the linear polymer was cleared rapidly relative to the other polymers, whereas the BB polymers displayed higher exposure over time.
concentration_time_figure.note: Dose-normalised plasma concentration; comparator architectures gave 2.7 h (linear) and >35 h (bottlebrush).

bioanalytical_method: Liquid scintillation counting per PEPlife2's Assay field
notes: The PEPlife2 value of 14.6 ± 2.9 h matches the body's '14.6 h' for CP, described as intermediate between the linear polymer's 2.7 h and the bottlebrush polymers' >35 h. THE SEQUENCE IS NOT A PEPTIDE SEQUENCE. PEPlife2 stores 'lKlW' - four characters in mixed case, marking alternating D- and L-residues - which is a monomer or repeat unit of a polymer architecture, not a molecule. The label is set by that architecture (linear vs comb vs bottlebrush spans 2.7 to >35 h for related materials), none of which the string encodes; after one-letter cleaning it becomes the four residues LKLW and the D-configuration is lost as well. The readout is also total radioactivity by scintillation counting rather than intact-species concentration, and the body gives no strain, sex, group size, dose or route.
